detailed_descriptions.en: Get ready for The Karters 2: Turbo Charged , a fast-paced, action-packed racer built for casual chaos and competitive mastery. With intense multiplayer, deep mechanics, and full modding support available from day one, it’s a karting experience with no speed limit and no limits on creativity. Key Features: Split-Screen (up to 6 players!) with Split-Screen Online Support Ghost Race with an option to download and share ghost data from Leaderboards Steam Workshop support (1500+ mods already - Tracks, Characters and more) Integrated Mod Browsing support directly in the game Online support with dedicated servers Ranked matchmaking support Single-Player Campaign Global Rankings (Leaderboards, Monthly ELO rankings, All-Time ELO Rankings, Tournaments) 16 official Race Tracks 6 Battle Arenas Team VS Team (online and local) Cups with up to 24 rounds (Team VS Team & Online support) Next Best Ghost option 7 Game Modes ( Race, Time Trial, Duo-Time Trial, Battle without time limit, Elimination, Road Breaker, Quick Cut, more to come!) We are a small indie studio from Poland with a goal to create the best kart racing game on the platform!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Get ready for The Karters 2: Turbo Charged, a fast-paced, action-packed racer built for casual chaos and competitive mastery. With intense multiplayer, deep mechanics, and full modding support available from day one, it’s a karting experience with no speed limit and no limits on creativity.

Key Features:

  • Split-Screen (up to 6 players!) with Split-Screen Online Support

  • Ghost Race with an option to download and share ghost data from Leaderboards

  • Steam Workshop support (1500+ mods already - Tracks, Characters and more)

  • Integrated Mod Browsing support directly in the game

  • Online support with dedicated servers

  • Ranked matchmaking support

  • Single-Player Campaign 

  • Global Rankings (Leaderboards, Monthly ELO rankings, All-Time ELO Rankings, Tournaments)

  • 16 official Race Tracks

  • 6 Battle Arenas

  • Team VS Team (online and local)

  • Cups with up to 24 rounds (Team VS Team & Online support)

  • Next Best Ghost option

  • 7 Game Modes ( Race, Time Trial, Duo-Time Trial, Battle without time limit, Elimination, Road Breaker, Quick Cut, more to come!)

We are a small indie studio from Poland with a goal to create the best kart racing game on the platform!
